case.summary: Case HHG-011 was opened after customer C11923 reported an unauthorized $131.30 online transaction (txn 3583368) on card C11923-K2. Analysis identified an episode of 4 online transactions between 2016-12-27 05:19:26 and 2016-12-29 15:42:09 totaling $149.83. The transactions were initiated via a newly recognized device profile D009680 (SM-G610F Build/NRD90M | chrome 66.0 for android) following a card-testing pattern. Model evaluation indicated a 0.98 calibrated fraud probability, supported by 5 of 5 similar prior cases confirmed as card-not-present fraud. The card was blocked and a case created, with no SAR filed due to exposure remaining below $1,000 without coordinated network indicators.
